title: ref.updated payload v1
description: A ref of the repository moved (a push, a forced push, a creation or a deletion), as the forge reported it in repository.pushed. Written on the repository channel only: the same push delivered as pull_request.head_ref.pushed journals pr.pushed and no ref record, so a push is recorded once.

before.description: The tip before the move; 40 zeros when the ref was created.

after.description: The tip after the move; 40 zeros when the ref was deleted.

created.description: The move created the ref. A window that holds this record holds every later move of the ref.

forced.description: The move rewrote history: the before tip is not an ancestor of the after tip.

pushed_at.description: The forge's push time (repository.pushed pushedAt), or the event time when the forge sent none.

pr.description: Null: a ref move is not a pull request event.

sha.description: The tip after the move (the subject of the record).
